## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/admin/ai/config`

Get AI config (api key masked)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Success | `application/json`: object |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `api_key` | string | no | Always masked. |
| `auto_analyze` | boolean | no | - |
| `base_url` | string | no | - |
| `enabled` | boolean | no | - |
| `has_api_key` | boolean | no | - |
| `max_tokens` | integer | no | - |
| `model` | string | no | - |
| `provider` | string | no | - |
| `system_prompt` | string | no | - |
| `timeout_secs` | integer | no | - |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/ai-analysis/{artifactID}/trigger`

Trigger AI analysis

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `artifactID` | path | string | yes | - |

**Request body**

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `artifact_format` | string | no | Optional; taken from the stored artifact when omitted. |
| `artifact_name` | string | no | Optional; taken from the stored artifact when omitted. |
| `artifact_version` | string | no | Optional; taken from the stored artifact when omitted. |
| `manifest_text` | string | no | Optional manifest text sent to the model as-is (max 256 KiB). When omitted the server reads the manifest from the stored artifact. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `202` | Queued | - |
| `404` | Repository not found, or no manifest_text given and the artifact is not in the repository | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `422` | No manifest_text given and no manifest can be read from this kind of artifact (for example docker images and raw files) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `503` | AI analysis is not enabled | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `default` | Error | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
